model.title: Rural Jobs and Hydropower Expansion Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal law to make it easier for private companies and other non-government entities to develop hydropower projects on dams and water infrastructure managed by the Bureau of Reclamation, aiming to expand renewable energy production in rural areas while reducing the federal government's role in such development.
